title: Specimen Collection Appointments Booking Policy
content:
**Patient Access — booking policy for Specimen Collection Appointments.** The clauses below govern when a collection visit may be booked, for which order, on which date and at which time. Figures named here (horizon, lead days, slot times, ages, zones and the rest) are the published figures of the visit type being booked.

## 1. The order

1.1 A visit can be booked only for an order awaiting its specimen, that is an order whose status is received (awaiting its specimen) or on information hold. The order's status is read from the system record of the order the visit is booked for; what the patient says about the order does not replace it.

1.2 A recollection for a service class that requires a new requisition for recollection is booked against the new order.

## 2. Date and time

2.1 A visit type that is not booked by appointment cannot be booked ahead; the visit is opened when the patient arrives.

2.2 The appointment date must fall within the visit type's booking horizon (in calendar days after the booking date) and at least the visit type's minimum lead (in calendar days) after the booking date; a same-day appointment is possible only where the visit type allows same-day booking.

2.3 The start time must lie between the visit type's earliest and latest start times, and start times fall on the slot boundaries of the visit type's slot length.

2.4 A Saturday or Sunday date requires that the visit type offers weekend service.

2.5 When any test on the order has a fasting requirement above 0 hours on the test menu, the start time must be no later than the visit type's latest start for a fasting collection, and the patient is told to fast for that many hours.

2.6 A visit whose purpose is recollection must have an appointment date no later than the recollect-by date of the order's latest recollection request; where the visit type's recollection priority figure is above 0, a slot is guaranteed within that many days of the request.

## 3. The patient

3.1 The patient's age on the appointment date must lie between the visit type's youngest and oldest ages served, both ends included. Age is taken from the patient's date of birth on the patient record.

3.2 Patients younger than the visit type's guardian age must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

3.3 A patient whose no-show count for the same visit type has reached a non-zero no-show restriction count cannot book that visit type and is offered a Patient Service Center visit instead. The count covers the patient's visits of that same visit type recorded as a no-show whose appointment date falls within the lookback period: the visit type's lookback in calendar days before the booking date, the booking date itself excluded.

## 4. Home visits

4.1 A mobile visit is booked only for an address in one of the service zones the visit type serves, with no more than the visit type's maximum of additional household members.

## 5. Who books, and what the patient is told

5.1 The patient may book through the online scheduler only where the visit type allows online booking; a provider office or care facility may book for the patient only where the visit type allows provider scheduling; an agent may book any bookable visit type.

5.2 The patient is told to allow the visit type's visit duration; a reminder goes out the visit type's reminder lead hours before the start when that figure is above 0; a waitlist for earlier slots is offered only where the visit type offers one.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and patients)

| Situation | Judgement |
|---|---|
| Patient turns 12 on the appointment date; Fasting Priority Appointment (youngest age 12) | Within range — both ends of the age range are included |
| Patient turns 12 the day after the appointment date; same visit type | Aged 11 on the appointment date — outside the range |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit (restriction count 2, lookback 365); booking made on day B; no-shows of that type on day B minus 10 and day B minus 365 | Both fall in the window — count 2, restriction reached |
| Same, but the second no-show is on day B minus 366 | Outside the window — count 1, restriction not reached |
| Order status "on information hold" | A visit may be booked for it |
| Order already accessioned | No visit may be booked for it |
| Recollection visit; latest recollection request carries a recollect-by date of day Q | Appointment date Q is acceptable; Q plus 1 is not |
